long_description:
Get ready to show off your killer Bollywood dance moves at our in-person auditions for the ultimate dance extravaganza!

About this Event

Bollywood Dance Auditions
Desi Caliente is a Bhangra/Bollywood dance performance company based out of Denver, CO. We do shows all arounds the Denver/Boulder metro area. We are starting a new season in 2027. Come audition to be part of this amazing group. We focus on technique and working hard to make the routines look good but also have fun. You don't need to come prepared with a routine, I will be posting a choreography breakdown for a Bhangra and a Bollywood song by December 15th. You can learn this on your own first and also at the Audition.
No cost to Audition but please RSVP so we know who is coming.
Level: This is somewhat of an advanced performance group and some prior experience either in Bollywood or other dance styles would be helpful.
Rehearsal schedule: We meet every Sunday from 10:30am to 12:30pm at Colorado dancesport which is at the intersection of I-25 and Hwy 36.

Thanks
Subbu
